name: newsletter
title: Newsletter signup
description: A grocery's weekly offers letter in one tinted band: a produce photo, the pitch, an inline email field and three facts.
author: themes.dev

files.content:
import { Bell, CalendarClock, Mail, ShoppingBasket, type LucideIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input" import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label" export type ImageRef = { src: string; alt: string; width: number; height: number } export type LinkRef = { label: string; href: string } export type Fact = { label: string; note: string } export type NewsletterProps = { kicker: string title: string body: string photo: ImageRef /** The small tag on the photo: what this week's letter is. */ tag: string /** The icon on the photo tag. */ mark: LucideIcon form: { action: string; label: string; placeholder: string; submit: string; note: string; privacy: LinkRef } facts: Fact[] } export const newsletterDefaults: NewsletterProps = { kicker: "Vershoek weekly", title: "Next week's offers, in your inbox on Sunday", body: "The offers for all 38 Vershoek shops in Utrecht province, one seasonal recipe and what came in from local growers that week.", photo: { src: "https://www.themes.dev/ui/photos/newsletter/crate.webp", alt: "A wooden crate of leeks, red apples, carrots and cauliflower", width: 480, height: 480, }, tag: "Week 48: veg from Houten", mark: ShoppingBasket, form: { action: "/newsletter", label: "Email address", placeholder: "you@example.com", submit: "Subscribe", note: "One email a week. Unsubscribe with one click at the bottom of every letter.", privacy: { label: "How we use your address", href: "/privacy" }, }, facts: [ { label: "Sundays at 18:00", note: "before the week's offers start" }, { label: "41,600 households", note: "already read it" }, { label: "€3 voucher", note: "in your first letter" }, ], } const factIcons = [CalendarClock, Mail, Bell] export function Newsletter(props: Partial) { const c = { ...newsletterDefaults, ...props } const f = c.form const Mark = c.mark return (

{c.kicker}

{c.title}

{c.body}

{f.note}{" "} {f.privacy.label}

    {c.facts.map((fact, i) => { const Icon = factIcons[i % factIcons.length] return (

  • {fact.label}{" "} {fact.note}

    • ) })}
) }
